Presets come from theme.json's settings.custom.gridHoverBlur — add more there to offer them here.
Flat link list renders top-level links o: Flat link list renders top-level links only, e.g. footer link columns.
Choose on which screen sizes this naviga: Choose on which screen sizes this navigation renders.
Adds a border around the hamburger icon: Adds a border around the hamburger icon button. Applies the same way whether this block is placed as the desktop or mobile hamburger.
Removes the divider lines between items: Removes the divider lines between items in the hamburger panel, including nested accordion children. Doesn't change content or expand/collapse behavior.
When on, clicking a link with a real URL: When on, clicking a link with a real URL navigates to it. Links with '#' or no URL still toggle the panel.
Hovering one top-level link dims and blu: Hovering one top-level link dims and blurs the rest of the bar. Turn off anytime to revert.
Off: only dropdown links (nav links\/sub: Off: only dropdown links (nav links/submenus) blur. On: the search and language items blur and trigger the effect too.
Solid colour shown while a page loads or: Solid colour shown while a page loads or changes, before the glass blur returns. Empty uses the site background.
